property_summary: For every call to C.transfer that completes (does not revert), the reference returns true; the mutant returns false, so the property is that successful calls return true (assert that invoking transfer yields a boolean true), which the mutant violates for any successful invocation.
change_summary: Return the negation of the original true (i.e., return '!true' -> false) by replacing the return statement with 'return !true;'.
